## Proposed change
<!-- 
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
In order to support multiple devices, creation of sensor entities gets delayed until the unique electricity ID was received (which should actually happen in every received message). This ID then gets used to construct a globally unique entity ID. Existing unique IDs get converted.
To make distinction of devices easier, a name option was added, too.


  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/

-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened instead.
-->

It's not possible to add more than one energy-meter. I try to add a second energy-meter for my heat pump. The read values toggle between energy-meter 1 and 2 (see picture)
When I try to add parameter "name" in the configuration.yaml, I get the following issue message while checking configuration.yaml file:

Invalid config for [sensor.edl21]: [name] is an invalid option for [sensor.edl21]. Check: sensor.edl21->name. (See ?, line ?). 

Maybe parameter "name" is missing to identify multiple instances?


## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant release with the issue: 0.107.5
- Last working Home Assistant release (if known): 
- Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.): Hass.io on RPi4 + 2 Weidmann USB optical read/write adapter for energy-meter
- Integration causing this issue: EDL21
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/edl21/

<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
sensor:
    #Zaehler Haushalt
  - platform: edl21
    #I try this, but get issue message while checking the configuration.yaml
    name: Zaehler1
    serial_port: /dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_FT230X_Basic_UART_DN06BU8I-if00-port0

    #Zaehler Waermepumpe
  - platform: edl21
    serial_port: /dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_FT230X_Basic_UART_D306NKPC-if00-port0
```

## Traceback/Error logs

  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt

```
